summary: Learn GRI, SASB, and ISSB reporting through practical exercises. Build credible disclosures and board-ready ESG reporting packs.
lede: ESG reporting frameworks help sustainability, reporting and investor-relations professionals organize disclosures around material topics. Through practical exercises, learners select frameworks, prioritize topics, map GRI disclosures and SASB metrics, and outline ISSB sustainability and climate-related disclosures under IFRS standards. They also practice building materiality matrices, validating ESG data and preparing reporting packs with evidence trails for stakeholder review.
audienceIntro: This ESG reporting frameworks course is built for professionals who already touch sustainability, annual reporting, risk, or investor communications and now need to produce stronger disclosures with GRI, SASB, and ISSB logic.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working familiarity with corporate reporting, sustainability or ESG terminology, and basic Excel-based data handling. Prior exposure to GRI, SASB, or ISSB is helpful but not mandatory. No programming is required. Advanced disclosure concepts are taught at the operational application level, with hands-on practice in framework mapping, materiality analysis, and reporting templates.
